  • Low-Emission Furniture and Slatted Frames made of Wood an Wood-Based Material

Low-Emission Furniture and Slatted Frames made of Wood an Wood-Based Material (DE-UZ 38)

chair, bed, wardrobe, table, shelf, desk
  • Publications
    • The Blue Angel for low-emission furniture and slatted frames made of wood and wood-based materials
  • Basic Award Criteria
    • Basic Award Criteria (PDF)
    • Application Documents (ZIP)
    • To apply (RAL portal)

Wood for a good indoor climate
Products made of wood or wood-based materials, such as furniture or slated frames, may cause an environmental impact during their production, use and disposal.
The Blue Angel eco-label considers the whole life cycle of a product and promotes, above all, the use of wood from sustainably managed forests and of low-emission wood-based materials.
